brief.en: Gives suns and powers up adjacent shadow plants
brief.zh: 生产阳光并强化周围的暗影植物

description.en: Moonflowers radiate a glow that powers up adjacent shadow plant.
description.zh: 月光花释放可以使周围暗影植物进入暗影状态的月光。

chat.en: Moonflower is a fierce collaborator. She'll collaborate with anything. She'd collaborate with a table if she could.
chat.zh: 月光花非常喜欢合作。她可以和任何事物合作。如果可以的话，她甚至能和一张桌子合作。

text.en: emits sun as well as additional sun for each adjacent shadow plant up to four
text.zh: 随着身边暗影植物增多而增多，四株（包括自己）时最多
